S0422.reason: Strict product liability requires the defendant be a merchant seller of the product, not knowledge or fault.

S0423.reason: No agreement to rob a bank existed; mere knowledge of some unspecified crime is insufficient for conspiracy.

S0424.reason: All peremptory norms create erga omnes obligations, but erga omnes obligations can also arise from other sources like objective-regime treaties or unilateral acts.
